title: [finding] pm-dispatch platform reading: in this repo a draft conversion alone did NOT remove a queued PR from the merge queue (PR #20695), contrary to `platform-readings.md:42`
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 2 PM (`session_014EJ1ED8X4MMrT18BhVx4tx`) at sign-off, as a platform-fact change for the seat protocol (the handover-report class "平台事实变化"). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The reading

PR #20695's timeline (`GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/20695/timeline`):

| time (UTC) | event | actor |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 2026-09-29T23:31:31Z | `auto_merge_enabled` | objectstack-fleet[bot] |
| 2026-09-29T23:32:51Z | `added_to_merge_queue` | objectstack-fleet[bot] |
| 2026-09-29T23:57:02Z | `convert_to_draft` | objectstack-fleet[bot] |
| 2026-09-30T00:04:21Z | `merged`, then `removed_from_merge_queue` | objectstack-fleet[bot], github-merge-queue[bot] |

The PR stayed in the queue after the draft conversion and merged 7 minutes later. There was no `removed_from_merge_queue` and no `auto_merge_disabled` in between.

## What the protocol text says

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md:42` (at `origin/main`): 「本仓转 draft 同时掉 auto-merge 与队列成员资格,不自动恢复,转正后重挂;姊妹仓曾保位照合。」 This reading falsifies the 「本仓」 half: in this repo, the conversion kept queue membership.
- `:41` (「两向相反读数并存,处置按最坏走」) and `:43` (「转 draft 与卸载 auto-merge 都做」) stay right. This reading adds a data point for `:41`.
- **Disclosure:** the seat sent only the draft conversion, not the auto-merge disable that `SKILL.md:202` and `:43` name alongside it. So whether the two together dequeue was not measured here. What was measured is that the draft conversion alone did not.

## Consequence (why it matters)

- PR #20695 merged with `Console Pin Gate` red in its queue build. That check is not required.
- `main` carried the red from `fbec216e2d` until the fix PR #20743 landed as `9c8f113c64`, about 2 h 17 min later. The card #20646 records both.

## Suggested disposition (for the skills seat)

Amend `:42` so this repo reads "mixed", like its sister repos, citing this PR. The remedy line `:43` already covers the worst case.
